被贬废丹房，我偷偷无敌了最新章节_第7章 先天优势第1页_被贬废丹房，我偷偷无敌了一朵青莲_热点小说网
> 第7章 先天优势（第1页）
陈长生苦笑，“您也看见了，这些人不给他打疼了，以后日子没法过了。”
丹老灌了口酒，眼中精芒一闪，“我的意思是说，要是我就给他们全部留下来了。你记住，斩草不除根，春风吹又生！”
“哦！”陈长生惊讶看了眼丹老，这一刻的老人就像是一把即将出鞘的利剑，此剑一出，必斩破苍穹！
陈长生把灵石递给丹老，“前辈，您拿去买酒喝吧！”
“哦？你居然都把钱给我买酒喝？”这下轮到丹老惊讶了，毕竟两百灵石对于陈长生来说已经是不少的财富了，居然这么大方。
陈长生点点头，“当然，要不是前辈赐我好酒，我的丹田怎么可能恢复呢，我的半条命都是前辈赐予的。”
接下来，陈长生把李怀安的储物戒指给炼化了。
随即把里面的东西一股脑倒了出来，除了些炼器材料，就一些普通丹药和少量几块灵石。
其实最珍贵的就是那张紫霄神雷符，刚刚李怀安真气紊乱，没法激发，都便宜陈长生了。
陈长生叹息一声，“这应该是炼制飞剑的材料，可惜的是我不会炼器。”
丹老随手扔来一枚玉简，“我这里有炼制飞剑的秘法，你可以试试看。”
“可是我没有炉鼎。”陈长生现在才是炼气期，如果到了结丹期的话体内会诞生出丹火来，到时候炼器根本就不需要炉鼎。
丹老把陈长生带到废丹房的深处，从一个废墟中扒拉出来一个炉鼎。
现在有炉鼎，地火，还有炼器材料，炼制飞剑的条件都齐全了。
陈长生把丹老给的玉简贴在额头上，顿时一股信息传进了识海之中，“炼器总纲”几个大字缓缓浮现。
陈长生一看就知道这本书很不简单，看得云里雾里，要不是他打小就穿越过来，文学底子扎实的话根本就看不懂。
好在陈长生上一世就是大学毕业，还是学习的汉语言文学专业，只花了几个小时时间就把炼制飞剑的知识都大概看了个明白。
当然，《炼气总纲》之中更深奥的东西肯定还有，但是炼制飞剑相对来说还算简单。

好在废丹房里没有什么事情做，他现在最不缺的就是时间，像他以前在丹房，天天忙成狗，哪里有时间研究这个。
所以说，在废丹房真的是不错，起码可以安心修炼，安心学习，这在其它任何地方都是没有的优势。
“嗯？你这么快就悟透了，不需要我给你分析了？”丹老正躺在垃圾堆上喝酒，看见陈长生准备炼器不由吃了一惊。
“炼制飞剑的材料可是不便宜，炼废了可没钱买了。”
陈长生点点头，“我知道的，我感觉差不多了。”
丹老胡子一撅，“是么，我来考考你《炼器总纲》里面关于炼制飞剑的知识，看看你小子领悟了多少。”
陈长生嘻嘻一笑，“您老请考吧！”
接下来经过一番考核丹老彻底惊呆了，因为陈长生竟然全会。
丹老无语的道：“不是吧，当年我可是花了将近半个月时间才把这些知识啃透的，你小子还是个人了？”

After being demoted to the alchemy room, I secretly became invincible. The latest chapter_Chapter 7 Innate Advantage Page 1_After being demoted to the alchemy room, I secretly became invincible to a green lotus_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 7 Innate Advantages (Page 1)
Chen Changsheng smiled bitterly, "As you can see, if these people don't give him a painful beating, he will not be able to survive the rest of his life."
Dan Lao took a sip of wine and a gleam flashed in his eyes, "What I mean is, if I let them all stay. Remember, if you cut the weeds without removing the roots, they will grow again with the spring breeze!"
"Oh!" Chen Changsheng looked at Elder Elixir in surprise. At this moment, the old man was like a sharp sword about to be unsheathed. Once the sword is drawn out, it will cut through the sky!
Chen Changsheng handed the spirit stone to Elder Dan, "Senior, take it to buy some wine!"
"Oh? You actually gave me the money to buy me a drink?" Now it was Elder Eun's turn to be surprised. After all, two hundred spirit stones were already a lot of wealth for Chen Changsheng, yet you were so generous.
Chen Changsheng nodded, "Of course, if senior hadn't given me the good wine, how could my Dantian have recovered? Half of my life was given by senior."
Next, Chen Changsheng refined Li Huaian's storage ring.
Then he poured out the contents, except for some weapon refining materials, some ordinary elixirs and a few spiritual stones.
In fact, the most precious thing is the Zixiao Divine Thunder Talisman. Just now, Li Huaian's true energy was out of order and could not be stimulated, so Chen Changsheng took advantage of it.
Chen Changsheng sighed, "This should be the material for refining the flying sword. It's a pity that I don't know how to refine weapons."
Elder Dan threw a jade slip casually, "I have a secret method for refining a flying sword. You can try it."
"But I don't have a cauldron." Chen Changsheng is currently in the Qi refining stage. If he reaches the pill forming stage, elixir fire will be born in his body, and then there will be no need for a furnace cauldron at all.
Elder Dan took Chen Changsheng to the depths of the ruined alchemy room and pulled out a furnace cauldron from the ruins.
Now that there is a furnace, earth fire, and weapon refining materials, the conditions for refining the flying sword are complete.
Chen Changsheng put the jade slip given by Elder Dan to his forehead, and suddenly a stream of information was transmitted into the sea of ​​​​consciousness, and the words "General Guidelines for Refining Weapons" slowly appeared.
Chen Changsheng knew at first glance that this book was not simple. He was confused and confused. If he hadn't traveled through time since he was a child and had a solid foundation in literature, he wouldn't be able to understand it at all.
Fortunately, Chen Changsheng graduated from college in his last life, majoring in Chinese language and literature. It only took him a few hours to understand the basics of refining flying swords.
Of course, there must be more profound things in the "General Guide to Qi Refining", but refining a flying sword is relatively simple.
Fortunately, there is nothing to do in the useless alchemy room. The most important thing he lacks now is time. Like when he was in the alchemy room before, he was so busy every day that he had no time to study this.
Therefore, it is really good to be in the Waste Alchemy Room. At least you can practice and study with peace of mind. This is an advantage that cannot be found anywhere else.
"Huh? You figured it out so quickly, don't you need me to analyze it for you?" Elder Dan was lying on the garbage heap drinking, and he couldn't help but be surprised when he saw Chen Changsheng preparing to refine the weapon.
"The materials for refining the flying sword are not cheap. If it's useless, you won't have the money to buy it."
Chen Changsheng nodded, "I know, I feel it's almost done."
Old Dan raised his beard and said, "Really? I'm going to test your knowledge about refining flying swords in the "General Guide to Weapon Refining" to see how much you understand."
Chen Changsheng smiled and said, "You always take the exam!"
After some tests, Dan Lao was completely shocked because Chen Changsheng actually knew all the tests.
Dan Lao said speechlessly: "No, it took me nearly half a month to learn all this knowledge. Are you still a human being?"
